title: Exponential population, n = 30
intro: Times between calls to a help desk are exponential with rate λ = 0.25 per minute: mean 4 minutes, standard deviation 4 minutes, strongly skewed to the right. The computer took 5000 samples of **n = 30** times (seed 1) and drew the histogram of their means, with the normal curve the Central Limit Theorem predicts: mean μ = 4 and standard error σ/√n = 4/√30 = 0.7303 minutes.
